title: Silver snake comes out of the burnt tree

tellings.quote: of a sudden, this snake comes out of the tree. This silver snake.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs show up around him, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about something he saw in his backyard in North Carolina, some time after a trip to Zanesville. He says that all of a sudden a silver snake came out of a burnt tree. He tells it as one more strange event in a life he says is full of them.
